title: TRUST ME, BRO
core: Drag highlighted gold blocks out of a real 3D rigid-body support tower while keeping the engineer upright. Free undo, no timer.

skills.game-design: First easy physical pull; six distinct structures and free recoveries, no idle completion.
skills.game-art: Rounded engineering toys, orange/cobalt/wood material language, original human inspector and detailed desk/roof/moon sets.
skills.3d-games: Cannon 3D boxes/contacts/point constraints; Three original meshes, blob shadows on phone, bounded render work.
skills.web-games: Bundled libraries and classic self-contained HTML, no CDN/runtime images.
skills.mobile-games: Single-pointer horizontal-plane drag, hold-to-pull alternative, cancel/pause/save, portrait/landscape44px controls.
skills.game-audio: Synthesized friction ticks, wood contact, clear/near-tip chords with bounded voices; no copied music.

reference: Official Jenga Cat Steam trailer: green alternating block tower, yellow cat, desert, reduced tower and score220/target200 observed. No native reference play, full completion, copied media/code or popularity claim. Rezona Pigeon Panic inspected then rejected as repeating earlier Bonnet Bay.
dedup: No extraction/balance tower loop found in full prefs/README search. Wobble Wizards stacks falling bricks, Wah-Recking swings a wrecking ball; these are concrete related physics games but different core action. Avoid sticky-ball growth/swallowing/suction, golf, hockey, elastic fitting, office mischief, tank driving.
